lines.zh: 我卡在叶柄的弯处，像个红点。
lines.en: I sit in the bend of the stem like a red dot.
Only a few strands of silk, very fine.
I hang and sway faintly.

lines.zh: 风大的时候，我整片转过去。
lines.en: In strong wind I turn right around.
After rain the red is brighter.

lines.zh: 我从叶隙里看下面的地。
lines.en: Through the leaf gaps I see the ground.
High up, and far.
I dare not think of falling.
The vine puts out new tendrils.
They curl past me.

lines.zh: 我跟着它转了一点角度。
lines.en: I turn with them a little.
And stay.
The sunlight shifts over.
My red shell goes translucent.

lines.zh: 里面那对翅膀的形状看得见。
lines.en: The shape of the wings inside shows.
I tuck it back into shadow.

lines.zh: 我停住，只有壳在呼吸一样地动。
lines.en: I stop; only my shell moves, as if breathing.
Red stands out sharply against green.

lines.zh: 所以我尽量贴在叶脉上。
lines.en: So I press against the vein.

lines.zh: 叶脉的颜色深，能遮一点。
lines.en: The vein is dark and hides a little.
A wasp flies near.
It circles me twice.
I do not move at all.
The wasp finishes its circles and leaves.

lines.zh: 丛林里到处是这种试探。
lines.en: The jungle is full of such tests.
I am used to it.

lines.zh: 有一只蜗牛爬过藤，留下亮线。
lines.en: A snail crosses the vine, leaving a bright trail.

lines.zh: 它从我的红壳旁边过去。
lines.en: It passes beside my red shell.

lines.zh: 你的影子落下来，红壳暗了。
lines.en: Your shadow falls and my red shell dims.

lines.zh: 红壳一露，你的目光就上来了。
lines.en: One flash of red and your eyes come up.
So red, hard to hide.

lines.zh: 我没有眼睛，但我知道你在看。
lines.en: I have no eyes, but I know you are looking.
You tilt your head.
I turn half about with the wind.
You see my front again.
So we look at each other.
You lower your head first.
I am still hanging there.
A white mark appears on the red shell.
Two spins; the silk winds tight.

lines.zh: 里面那对翅膀动了一下。
lines.en: The wings inside shift once.
I hang at the leaf's edge, swinging hard.
It hurts and I cannot cry out.
I can only wait for it to pass.
Wind helps hide my red.
Slowly I stop shaking.
The leaf's back took that blow for me.
The red shell holds; I still hang.
I don't eat; I'm becoming wings.

lines.zh: 红色不是给你摘的意思。
lines.en: The red is not an invitation.
You hold up a fruit.
I cannot see its shape.
Only a shadow.
Red isn't fruit here; it's a warning.
You hold it a long while.
Put it back.
I would rather hang here.
Nowhere else.
You pass below and brush the vine.
The vine jerks; I hit a leaf.
My red shell knocks a leaf.
A very soft sound.
You look up.

lines.zh: 我正好停在你的视线里。
lines.en: I happen to stop in your line of sight.
You reach up to steady me.
The wind pushes me away first.
You can't reach; I'm still up here.
Seven swings and still not still.
I am still in my shell.
My red wings are not dry.
That waits a long while.

lines.zh: 外面有翅膀振动的声音。
lines.en: Wings beat outside.
Red, like me.
It flies past.
It does not stop.
I am not ready either.
Wait a little more.
My shell is still warm.
Someone places me elsewhere.

lines.zh: 红色的壳在手指间很小。
lines.en: My red shell is small between fingers.

lines.zh: 我被带到有阳光的地方。
lines.en: I am brought into sunlight.
There is no canopy here.
I am exposed under the whole sky.
Too bright.
I shrink a little.
Someone drapes cloth over me.
Much better.
I keep waiting.

lines.zh: 有什么东西盯着这片红。
lines.en: Something is watching this red.
It lands under the leaf.
I cannot leave.
Only press my shell as tight as it goes.
The red is still red.
It touches me with its antennae.

lines.zh: 我连壳里的翅都不敢收。
lines.en: I dare not even fold the wings inside.
It tries several times.
At last it gives up.
I hear it fly off.
It has not gone far.
It circles on the neighbouring leaf.
I feel that gaze.

lines.zh: 我把红藏进叶脉的阴影。
lines.en: I hide the red in the vein's shade.
Time passes bit by bit.
The leaf softens in the sun.
I soften too.
At last it flies away.

lines.zh: 盯我的东西走了，我松开。
lines.en: Whatever was watching has gone; I relax.
Wind crosses the canopy.
I swing across from the leaf.
My red shell strikes its back.
Light, but it flinches.
It flutters back.
The silk tangles its wing.
It shakes its head and swings me wide.
It snaps.
I drop a foot, then stop.
I hang from the leaf, swinging hard.
A white line on my red shell.
A fleck of red on the vine.

lines.zh: 我原来是只带刺的毛虫。
lines.en: I was a spiny caterpillar once.
Now only this shell.
The red is what the caterpillar left me.
It spun on this leaf.
I hang below it.
The leaf cups a little dew.
I cannot reach it.
Nor do I need to.
Light passes through my red.

lines.zh: 火把红色的边烤成了褐色。
lines.en: Fire browns the edge of my red.

lines.zh: 我落到地上，壳裂了一条。
lines.en: I hit the ground and my shell splits.

lines.zh: 水泡软了丝线，我往下沉。
lines.en: Water softens the silk; I sink.
A force throws me clear.
It bounces off my shell.

lines.zh: 咒力让红色变成一片斑。
lines.en: Magic turns the red mottled.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，也不觉得饿。
lines.en: I do not eat, and do not hunger.
Lightning lights me fully red.

lines.zh: 红色在黑暗里没有意义。
lines.en: Red means nothing in the dark.
